notes.title: Many bug fixes
notes.content:
Many bug fixes
1. When items are dropped after being exploded, the client will not have a copy that cannot be built.
2. When the box is exploded, the equipment in the box will be exploded.
3. The problem of day and night out of sync and black and white screen flickering problem has been confirmed and fixed.

notes.title: Tried to fix multiple issues
notes.content:
1. A giant wall appears in the safe area
2. The sky screen on the client side flickers (I’m trying to fix it, I don’t know if it works, I’ll wait for everyone to verify it)
3. The weather is out of sync in foggy weather (I’m trying to fix it, but I don’t know if it will work, I’ll wait for everyone to verify it)
4. Plant entities will be loaded repeatedly
5. When picking up supplies, directly picking them up with one click will cause a lot of supplies to be lost. You need to pick up the backpack first.
